title: Dopl Technologies raises $6.3M to bring remote robotic ultrasound to rural hospitals

content_html:
TL;DR

Dopl raised $6.3M for a telerobotic ultrasound platform letting sonographers work remotely. Founded by ex-Nvidia AI engineer and practising cardiologists. FDA 510(k) pathway established. Targeting rural care gaps.

Dopl Technologies raised $6.3 million in seed funding led by SpringTide Ventures to advance a telerobotic ultrasound platform toward FDA clearance. The system, called Traverse, lets sonographers remotely operate a robotic arm via haptic controllers and cameras to perform diagnostic ultrasound exams on patients at distant sites. The platform is hardware-agnostic, integrating off-the-shelf robots and ultrasound systems into existing hospital infrastructure. Total funding is now over $8 million.

The company was founded in 2022 by a former Nvidia medical AI engineer alongside practising cardiologists and radiologists. The broader team includes alumni from Butterfly Network, Philips, Microsoft, and Amazon. Dopl has completed FDA pre-submission engagement and established a 510(k) regulatory pathway. The funding will support verification, validation, FDA submission, and initial pilot deployments at rural hospitals in Washington State.

While pursuing FDA clearance, Dopl launched CareBridge, an interim service that sends travelling sonographers to underserved hospitals in person. Patients in communities where Dopl operates see up to a 90% reduction in wait times. The plan is to transition these partner hospitals to the telerobotic system once it clears regulatory review. The company estimates a $40 billion annual reimbursement opportunity for US hospitals as telerobotic imaging scales nationally. Corti took a similar approach to medical coding, treating a broken clinical workflow as a reasoning problem and building AI around it rather than replacing clinicians.

More than 50 million Americans live in areas with limited access to diagnostic imaging. The sonographer shortage is structural: training takes years, the workforce is aging, and rural hospitals cannot recruit specialists to live in remote communities. AI has shown it can outperform biopsies in rare cancer assessment, but most imaging AI requires a human to acquire the scan in the first place. Dopl’s bet is that the acquisition step can also be done remotely, turning a sonographer shortage into a distribution problem that robotics and connectivity can solve.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Dopl 筹集了 630 万美元用于远程机器人超声平台，让超声检查师能够远程工作。 由前 Nvidia 人工智能工程师和执业心脏病专家创立。 FDA 510(k) 途径已建立。 针对农村护理差距。

Dopl Technologies 筹集了由 SpringTide Ventures 领投的 630 万美元种子资金，以推进远程机器人超声平台获得 FDA 批准。 该系统名为 Traverse，可让超声医师通过触觉控制器和摄像头远程操作机械臂，对远处的患者进行超声诊断检查。 该平台与硬件无关，将现成的机器人和超声系统集成到现有的医院基础设施中。 目前总资金已超过 800 万美元。

该公司由前 Nvidia 医疗人工智能工程师与执业心脏病专家和放射科医生于 2022 年创立。 更广泛的团队包括来自 Butterfly Network、飞利浦、微软和亚马逊的校友。 Dopl 已完成 FDA 提交前参与并建立了 510(k) 监管途径。 这笔资金将支持验证、确认、FDA 提交以及在华盛顿州乡村医院的初步试点部署。

在寻求 FDA 批准的同时，Dopl 推出了 CareBridge，这是一项临时服务，可将流动超声检查人员亲自送到服务不足的医院。 Dopl 开展业务的社区中的患者等待时间减少了 90%。 该计划是在通过监管审查后将这些合作医院过渡到远程机器人系统。 该公司预计，随着远程机器人成像在全国范围内的推广，美国医院每年可获得 400 亿美元的报销机会。 Corti 对医疗编码采取了类似的方法，将中断的临床工作流程视为推理问题，并围绕它构建人工智能，而不是取代临床医生。

超过 5000 万美国人生活在诊断成像服务有限的地区。 超声检查师的短缺是结构性的：培训需要数年时间，劳动力老龄化，乡村医院无法招聘到生活在偏远社区的专家。 人工智能已经表明，在罕见癌症评估中，它可以优于活检，但大多数成像人工智能首先需要人类进行扫描。 Dopl 的赌注是，采集步骤也可以远程完成，将超声波技师短缺转变为机器人和连接可以解决的分配问题。
